what: Circle where the pointer enters (diameter = farthest corner distance × 2) spreads over .45s cubic-bezier(.55,.05,.22,.99) to cover the button, and the text changes to the color shown on the cover. The text line rolls 90° on the x axis like a cube and the same text stands up again (.8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)). When the hand leaves, only after the spread has fully finished does the circle fade at that same size over .45s, and the rolled text stays rolled — on re-entry, the text and circle are reset to the start at once and spread again

options.--fx-on: Text color when covered (via style), default var(--kf-on-accent)
options.--fx-dur: Spread length (via style), default .45s — even if you let go, this length is fully filled (js reads this value)
options.--fx-ease: Spread curve (via style), default cubic-bezier(.55,.05,.22,.99) — the original of the large emphasis button is .5s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)
options.[data-fx-part=roll]: Rolling text line (child) — holds the same text twice (two spans). Without it only the circle spreads
options.--fx-text-dur: Duration of the text color change (via style), default .4s — the original small back button (c-tip-btn) is 0s

use: View detailsView details
note: The original attaches this only at 1024 and above with a mouse — if hover is false (touch), it does nothing. The button gets overflow hidden and isolation (so the circle goes behind the text)

from.where: shared.js button ([data-btn]) — original c-btn · c-hover-fill: diameter is max(distance to the four corners)×2, --ripple-duration .45s (large teal button .5s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)), --ripple-fade-duration .45s, on leave it waits for the remaining ripple length and then fades, text cube flip .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)
